pwts=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); spotify_pw=next(x['password'] for x in pwts if x['account_name']=='spotify'); login=apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw); access_token=login['access_token']
# following artists
following_ids=set();
page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('following page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        following_ids.add(a['artist_id'])
    page_index+=1
print('total_following_artists', len(following_ids))

# all playlists
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('playlists page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))

classical_songs=[]
classical_artist_ids=set()

for pl in all_playlists:
    pl_title=pl['title']
    for song_id in pl.get('song_ids', []):
        song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
        # song['genre'] expected; if missing, fall back to artists genre? but keep strict
        song_genre=song.get('genre')
        if song_genre=='classical':
            artists=song.get('artists', [])
            artist_ids=[a['id'] for a in artists if 'id' in a]
            artist_names=[a.get('name') for a in artists if a.get('name')]
            for aid in artist_ids:
                classical_artist_ids.add(aid)
            classical_songs.append({
                'playlist_title': pl_title,
                'song_id': song_id,
                'song_title': song.get('title'),
                'genre': song_genre,
                'artist_ids': artist_ids,
                'artist_names': artist_names
            })

print('classical_songs_count', len(classical_songs))
print('classical_unique_artist_count', len(classical_artist_ids))
# show filtered artifact
for item in classical_songs:
    print('CLASSICAL', item['playlist_title'], '|', item['song_title'], '| song_id', item['song_id'], '| artists', list(zip(item['artist_ids'], item['artist_names'])))
print('classical_artist_ids', sorted(classical_artist_ids))
print('already_following_classical_artist_ids', sorted(classical_artist_ids & following_ids))
print('to_follow_ids', sorted(classical_artist_ids - following_ids))
